source: new/1. Online Presence Review/_Online Presence Review Template.docx
note: The eight summary-table rows, in template order. `dimensions` are the words printed in the Comments column of the summary table — they are what the star score is a judgement about, and every snippet declares which one it speaks to.

categories.label: Website (Business)
categories.automation_note: Crawl finds the structural gaps (no service pages, no bio pages, no blog, public email domain, testimonials present). The taste calls — dated, generic, hiding behind the brand — need screenshots and a human or vision pass.

categories.label: Website (Technical)
categories.automation_note: Every snippet in this category triggers off a deterministic signal: TLS, CMS fingerprint, MX vs A record, analytics tags, /wp-admin reachability, host geo, measured load time.

categories.label: Website (Usability)
categories.automation_note: Playwright renders the page and reads computed styles, nav item counts, sticky behaviour, link targets, tap-target sizes; axe-core supplies contrast violations.

categories.label: Visibility (SEO)
dimensions: SERP Rankings (Practitioner, Profession, Location, Condition & Services)
categories.automation_note: On-page optimisation is automatic. Actual SERP positions need a rank provider — until one is connected, positions are entered by hand and the snippet fills from them.

categories.label: Visibility (SEM)
categories.automation_note: Whether the practice or its competitors are running ads is only visible from a live SERP. Manual entry until a SERP provider is connected.

categories.label: Reputation
dimensions: Reviews on Google and other channels
categories.automation_note: Review count, rating and negative-review handling need the Places API. Manual entry until then.

categories.label: Social Media
categories.automation_note: The crawl finds which social profiles the site links to. Follower counts and post cadence are hostile to scraping — entered by hand, roughly five minutes.

categories.label: Competition
categories.automation_note: Competitor discovery needs a SERP provider. Once a competitor domain is named, the collectors run the same technical and usability checks against it automatically and fill the row.
categories.empty_note: No competitors were identified for this review.

scoring.note: Stars are the reviewer's judgement, not an average. The engine suggests a score from the weighted balance of positive vs negative findings in the category; the reviewer can override any of them, and the override is what ships.
scoring.suggestion_rule: start at 5, subtract the summed weight of accepted negative findings, add back half the summed weight of accepted positives, clamp 1..5
